CustomField.formula: SLA_Start_1__c /* Date received */ + Case_Timer_Days__c /* Case Timer */ + TAT_Days__c - Case_Timer_Days__c /* Alloted TAT - Days already elapsed */ + if(ISBLANK(SLA_Start_2__c),0,SLA_Start_2__c - SLA_Stop_1__c - 1) /* If PO is approved calc days between quoted and approved (subtract one to account for overshoot)*/ + if(ISBLANK(SLA_Start_2__c),0,1) /* Add 1 day once PO approved to align timer with QAD (PO approved day doesnt count) */ + SLA_Days_Paused__c /* Days case was paused */ + SLA_Weekends_Holidays__c /* Days case was open that were not working days */
CustomField.label: Case Close Calc
